name: template-column
description: WordPress plugin: a sortable, filterable Template column for pages, posts and custom post types.
author: Ryan Sigg

scripts.lint:php: find template-column.php includes bin tests -name '*.php' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l
scripts.zip: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/template-column.zip && cd .. && zip -rq template-column/dist/template-column.zip template-column/template-column.php template-column/includes template-column/readme.txt template-column/LICENSE
